node.title: Mapping — govern AI merges without slowing down → compensating controls
node.summary: Maps 'govern AI merges without killing velocity' to compensating controls — ship behind a feature flag instead of a hard block; a human still merges.
node.interview_question: A feature flag is a developer convention, not governance — what makes this a control a CISO would sign off on?

competitor.name: GitHub Copilot
competitor.positioning: GitHub native rulesets/required reviews are the velocity-vs-control default; the incumbent argues you don't need a third party to gate merges.
